Thank you Hep!
Apr 2025 • Couples
We had a Cooking class taught by Hep. We were introduced to a new dish and a different style of fried rolls. Hep was amazing at showing the technique and explaining the ingredients, as well as a little bit of background of each dish. The place is a really cool open traditional wooden house. You are welcomed with some delicious juice drinks and proceed to the cooking. Everything was very well organized before we started. After each dish you take a time to enjoy it while it's still fresh or hot. I cannot recommend enough, specially if you are already staying in the Furama Resort.

One of the greatest place for food and meditation
Jan 2025 • Family
I love being at Taya House, just to look at things in here, everything is visually stunning yet still manage to make me feel like i'm at home with familiar and nostalgic vibe written all over the house. The wood, the floor combined with the chair, the beautiful view over the lagoon is a great combination. Not to mention the food here is unbelivably good. Even though i'm not a big fan of vegetarian food, the dishes here surprised me. I have a soft spot more mushroom so everything mushroom related especially the Canh Nấm Bổ Dưỡng (nutritious mushroom soup) hands down the best dish in Taya House. I highly recommend all the mushroom dishes along with all other vegetarian dishes. Try the tofu skin, it's excessively good.
